name: Satisfaction In God
overview: The Scriptures reveal that true satisfaction is found in the presence and guidance of God, where joy is full and pleasures endure forever. The psalmist expresses that beholding God's face in righteousness brings complete satisfaction and a heart that lives forever. Delight in the Lord leads to the fulfillment of the desires of the heart, and God's continual guidance sustains and satisfies the soul even in times of hardship, making the believer like a flourishing, well-watered garden.
